projects.title: ESP32-CAM CCTV System
projects.description: AI-based camera with YOLOv8, global live streaming, SD storage, and Flutter app.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional CCTV systems lack AI capabilities and are expensive to scale globally.
challenges: Achieving real-time streaming with minimal latency
solutions: Optimized YOLOv8 model for edge deployment
Used MUX for efficient video streaming
Implemented smart power management system

projects.title: Cinnamon Traceability Blockchain
projects.description: Blockchain-based system to trace cinnamon from cultivation to export using QR codes and Flutter app.

caseStudy.problem: Lack of transparency and traceability in the cinnamon supply chain reduces trust in export quality.
challenges: Mapping real-world supply chain to digital records
Ensuring stakeholder usability with minimal tech literacy
Generating real-time QR code tracking at every stage
solutions: Modeled all entities using Hyperledger Fabric smart contracts
Built a user-friendly mobile app with Flutter
Auto-generated QR codes for each batch and updated in real-time
learnings: Practical use of blockchain in agriculture

projects.title: Blockchain Medical Records System
projects.description: Research project comparing Ethereum, Corda, and Hyperledger for storing secure medical data.

caseStudy.problem: Medical records systems are vulnerable to breaches, lack interoperability, and face regulatory issues.
solutions: Benchmarked 3 blockchain platforms for performance and security
Modeled healthcare workflows on-chain for comparison
Proposed best-fit architecture for Sri Lankan health records
learnings: Deep understanding of blockchain consensus models

projects.title: Vehicle Repair Center Website
projects.description: A booking and management platform for vehicle repair services with backend database integration.

caseStudy.problem: Vehicle owners lacked a centralized, digital system to schedule repair services easily.
challenges: Designing for mobile and desktop users
Securing customer data and repair logs
solutions: Built dynamic forms and booking workflows using PHP and JS
Used SQL to manage appointments, customers, and mechanics
Responsive UI with CSS and Bootstrap
learnings: PHP and SQL integration for full-stack apps
User experience design for service apps
Database schema design for real-world operations

projects.title: Grocery Shop Management System
projects.description: A POS system for managing inventory, sales, and customer tracking in local grocery shops.

caseStudy.problem: Small retailers lacked a system to track inventory and generate sales reports efficiently.
challenges: Designing an intuitive GUI for non-tech users
solutions: Used JavaFX for desktop GUI interface
Connected to SQL database for live inventory control
Created custom PDF receipts and charts
learnings: Real-time DB sync in standalone apps

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description: A command-line system for handling book lending, returning, and catalog tracking.

caseStudy.problem: Libraries lacked a digital system for managing lending and return operations.
challenges: Building a user menu with basic terminal tools
solutions: Used structured C programs with file read/write operations
Created interactive menu-driven app
Backup and restore logic built using text dumps
learnings: File handling and struct usage in C

projects.title: Healthy Farm Crops Website
projects.description: Marketplace web app connecting local farmers with consumers for direct sales.

caseStudy.problem: Farmers couldn't easily connect with local buyers or list available produce online.
challenges: Making listings editable by farmers with little tech experience
solutions: PHP and JavaScript for listing forms and validation
SQL backend with category-based filtering
Used Bootstrap + CSS for mobile-responsiveness

projects.title: EXTRU Exhibition Website
projects.description: Official website for Rajarata University's EXTRU Exhibition, highlighting events, projects, and schedules.

caseStudy.problem: No centralized online hub for attendees and project presenters during the exhibition.
challenges: Creating a visually engaging layout in a short deadline
Keeping navigation simple for mobile users
solutions: Built static site using semantic HTML and responsive CSS
Added JS-based schedule toggles and countdowns
Deployed via GitHub Pages for ease of access
